Preferences

Settings

Small, durable controls for how Float behaves. Runtime actions still stay in the viewer.

Viewer behavior

These controls persist across launches and keep the viewer predictable when you reopen the app.

Lock aspect ratio

Keep manual window resizing constrained to the current image proportions.

Click-through overlay

Let the window stay visible without catching pointer input when you are using other apps underneath it.

Appearance

Keep the viewer legible, but soften how present it feels when it is floating above the rest of your screen.

Window opacity

Lower the viewer presence without making the image unreadable. Float keeps this within a safe visible range.

100%

Native blur

Uses the host compositor when available. Support can vary by platform and window manager.

Slideshow interval

The playback button in the viewer uses this interval whenever a session has more than one image.

Blur uses native window effects when the current platform supports them.

Shortcuts

Float keeps its main commands in the native menu. These are the active bindings for the current platform.
